Subject: Welcome to Divvi
Body (User-Facing Copy): You’re in. Divvi helps you plan trips, organize your group, and keep everything in one place. Start by creating your first trip or joining one you’ve been invited to. [Create a Trip] [Join a Trip]

Subject: Confirm your email
Body (User-Facing Copy): Confirm your email to finish setting up your account. [Confirm Email] If you didn’t create a Divvi account, ignore this.

Subject: Reset your password
Body (User-Facing Copy): Click below to reset your password. [Reset Password] If you didn’t request this, ignore this email.

Subject: Your trip is ready to build
Trigger: Trip "Save as Draft" state for 3 days
Body (User-Facing Copy): Your trip “{Trip Name}” has been created. Add details, invite guests, and finalize plans before publishing. [Continue Planning]

Subject: Your trip is live
Body (User-Facing Copy): “{Trip Name}” is now live. Guests can RSVP, choose beds, and start planning with you. [View Trip]

Subject: Your trip is confirmed
Body (User-Facing Copy): Your payment for “{Trip Name}” is complete. You can now invite guests and start collecting RSVPs. [Invite Guests]

Subject: You’re invited to {Trip Name}
Body (User-Facing Copy): {Host Name} invited you to join “{Trip Name}.” View trip details, choose your spot, and RSVP. [View Trip]

Subject: Reminder: {Trip Name}
Trigger: No RSVP state for 33%, 66%, 99% of [days between date published - date of day 1 of trip]
Body (User-Facing Copy): You haven’t responded to “{Trip Name}” yet. Spots may fill up soon. [View Trip]

Subject: You’re in
Body (User-Facing Copy): You’ve joined “{Trip Name}.” Next step: RSVP and choose your bed. [Complete RSVP]

Subject: RSVP confirmed
Body (User-Facing Copy): You’re going to “{Trip Name}.” You selected: Bed: {Bed Name} • Guests: {#} [View Trip]

Subject: Your RSVP was updated
Body (User-Facing Copy): Your RSVP for “{Trip Name}” has been updated. [View Details]

Subject: New RSVP for {Trip Name}
Body (User-Facing Copy): {Guest Name} just RSVP’d. Current status: {X}/{Capacity} spots filled. [View Trip]

Subject: {Trip Name} is filling up
Trigger: Half of capacity, 75% of capacity and 90% of capacity guests RSVP'd-yes
Body (User-Facing Copy): Spots are going quickly. {X} of {Capacity} spots are now taken. [View Trip]

Subject: {Trip Name} is full
Trigger: No RSVP state when max capacity guest count reached
Body (User-Facing Copy): This trip has reached capacity. You can still view details or join the waitlist. [View Trip]

Subject: {Trip Name} cost has been finalized
Body (User-Facing Copy): Your share for “{Trip Name}” is now finalized. Total due: ${Amount}. [View Breakdown]

Subject: {Trip Name} starts soon
Trigger: Trip is one week away (or if [days between date published - date of day 1 of trip] is less than one week, 3 days)
Body (User-Facing Copy): Your trip starts in {X days}. Check the itinerary and finalize any plans. [View Trip]

Subject: Today’s the day
Body (User-Facing Copy): Your trip starts today. Everything you need is in your trip dashboard. [Open Trip]

Subject: Today’s plan
Trigger: 7 am EST on trip day [day x]
Body (User-Facing Copy): Here’s what’s happening today: • {Event 1} • {Event 2} [View Full Itinerary]

Subject: Your trip recap
Trigger: 7 am EST on day after last trip day
Body (User-Facing Copy): Your trip “{Trip Name}” has ended. Relive the moments and highlights. [View Recap]

Subject: How was your trip?
Trigger: 7 am EST, one week after last trip day
Body (User-Facing Copy): Help us improve Divvi. [Leave Feedback]

Subject: Update on {Trip Name}
Body (User-Facing Copy): You no longer have access to this trip. Contact the host if this was a mistake.

Subject: {Trip Name} was canceled
Body (User-Facing Copy): This trip has been canceled by the host.

Subject: Welcome as Co-Host
Body (User-Facing Copy): [Host Name} has added you as a co-host of “{Trip Name}” [Manage Trip]
